Name: Naru Replaces Statue of Generosity
Author: Ameyana
Description:
Requires: [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url],  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7532]Statue of Generosity[/url].

Install by unzipping the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods and running the game using SMAPI.

There are a couple of config options. I highly recommend the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to make it easier to change these options.

If you don't want Naru to have seasonal outfit changes (I guess to better match the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/386?tab=description]Sailor Scarecrows[/url] mod), you can edit the config file to "No". You can also choose if you want Naru to have a "Green" or "Blue" bow with her schoolgirl uniform. The mod defaults to  Naru with seasonal outfit changes and green bow Naru.

---
I... uh. Just edited the Sailor Neptune sprite from Sailor Scarecrows a little to make Naru, so if the pose seems a little familiar, that's why. >_>
